description:
Crucible is a native client for your Plex Media Server on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, built to feel like part of the system: the system player, native menus and Liquid Glass.

SKIP WHAT DOESN'T MATTER
Essentials hides the anime-only episodes of long shows, the ones that adapt no manga chapter: Dragon Ball Super goes from 131 episodes to 110 and Up Next follows. The guides come from Crucible Guides, an open dataset (CC BY-SA). Skip Recap and Skip Preview read your files' own chapters, and Spoiler Shield hides what you haven't seen yet.

YOUR WHOLE PLEX SETUP
Connect Trakt to scrobble what you watch, see its score beside IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, and read, react to and write the reviews on every title. Connect Seerr, Overseerr or Jellyseerr to request what your server doesn't have, watch it arrive, then play it. Both stay off until you connect them.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Home opens on a Resume hero, then Continue Watching, Up Next and Recently Added. Libraries filter by Unwatched, In Progress and genre, with an A–Z scrubber.

ASK WHAT TO WATCH
Say what you feel like and What to Watch picks from your own library, with a reason for each. Previously On recaps your last episodes before you press play.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Instant Start has the picture ready as you press Play. Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, audio and subtitle menus, and Up Next as the credits start. On iPhone and iPad: scrub previews, Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Direct play or transcoding as needed.

MADE FOR IPAD
A sidebar with every library, layouts for every window size, multiple windows and a menu bar with keyboard shortcuts.

MADE FOR THE COUCH
The Apple TV app is built for the Siri Remote: a cinematic Home that follows focus, one tab per library and Top Shelf with Continue Watching and Up Next.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
On iPhone and iPad, download movies, seasons or single episodes in the quality you pick. Transfers continue in the background, with a Live Activity on iPhone.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
Watch History grouped by day, Statistics with streaks, heatmaps and binges from your Plex history, or with Trakt from everything you watch, and a Year in Review poster you can share.

FREE TO USE, CRUCIBLE PRO TO GO FURTHER
Browsing, search, playback, Trakt and requests are free on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and so is a week of Statistics. Crucible Pro unlocks What to Watch, Previously On, every comment and member on Trakt, unlimited offline downloads, full Statistics with every range and Everything from Trakt, the Year in Review poster, Top Shelf, and approving your household's requests. Pay once or yearly; one purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, with Family Sharing.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
Choose Try the demo on the welcome screen to explore a fictional library.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no analytics. Crucible talks to plex.tv and the server you choose, fetches episode guides as one file shared by everyone, records Crucible Pro purchases with an anonymous Midgar ID, and reaches Trakt or Seerr only once you connect them. What to Watch and Previously On send your request, your library's titles and episode descriptions to Crucible's AI, and only when you ask.

OPEN SOURCE
Crucible is free software under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/guitaripod/Crucible

Crucible needs a Plex Media Server. Plex requires a Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream from your server away from home. Crucible is an independent app and is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Plex, Inc. Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc. Crucible uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt.

Crucible Pro Annual: billed yearly at the price shown in the app. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/crucible/privacy
promotionalText: New: Instant Start has the picture ready as you press Play, and scrubbing shows a preview of every moment above your finger.
whatsNew:
New: Instant Start. The title you're about to play is made ready before you press Play, so the picture is there with the press: a title's page being open, a finger on a card and the title Home leads with when the app opens are enough. Nothing is spent ahead of Play on mobile data, in Low Power Mode or on a hot device, and Settings › Playback › Starting turns it off.

New: scrub previews. Drag the player's scrubber and a card above your finger shows the picture, the time and the chapter of that moment, the instant you point at it; with a trackpad or mouse, rest the pointer on the scrubber. The pictures are your server's video preview thumbnails, held ahead of the scrub, so that server setting has to be on; a download shows frames of its own file.

Scrubbing a stream your server converts no longer rebuilds it at every place you pass: it goes once, to where you let go.

Without Crucible Pro, What to Watch and a written recap now each give one real answer from your own library before asking for Pro: the first pick, or how the recap begins, with the rest sealed.

The player's close button now stops playback; swiping the player down keeps it playing in the mini player.

A folder button beside the library's sort and grid-size buttons opens its folders, and Browse Folders is in the Go menu on Shift-Command-O.

Fixed: the app closing when a hardware keyboard was used on iOS 17 and 18, and a Dolby Vision profile 7 file written as two video tracks failing once before it played.
